title: IT Systems Administrator
description:
**About The Role**
 Protsahan India Foundation operates 5 centres in Delhi, with 50\+ staff, each managing their own devices, alongside shared infrastructure — CCTVs, biometric attendance systems, WiFi networks, and programme equipment. As we scale, formal IT management is required for each of the 5 centers and the administrative office location.
   

  

 The IT Systems Administrator will own all of this — not as a helpdesk ticket\-taker, but as the person who makes sure none of it fails. You will be the single point of accountability for IT infrastructure, device health, data security, and digital compliance across all locations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Device Management
* Manage 50\+ laptops across 6 locations: setup, configuration, asset tagging, condition tracking, maintenance, and repair
* Maintain the IT asset register per Protsahan’s asset management SOPs — every device tracked by location, user, and condition
* Coordinate hardware procurement: obtain quotes, recommend vendors, and process purchase requests through Finance
* Manage device allocation for new joiners and secure retrieval at exit — within the timelines defined in HR SOPs
* Initiate and document write\-off requests for end\-of\-life devices per the disposal policy
* Network and Connectivity
* Manage WiFi, LAN, and internet connectivity at all 6 centre locations
* Troubleshoot network outages and connectivity issues; escalate to ISP vendors where required
* Maintain router and network device configurations; document network topology for each location
* Coordinate with ISP vendors on service quality, renewals, and upgrades
* CCTV Systems
* Maintain and monitor CCTV infrastructure at all 6 locations
* Manage CCTV storage: ensure recording continuity, footage retention per policy, and periodic storage health checks
* Control access to CCTV footage — only authorised personnel per the IT and Data Protection Policy
* Coordinate with CCTV vendors for installation, repair, and expansion
* Biometric Attendance Systems
* Maintain biometric attendance devices at all locations; ensure data sync and accuracy
* Coordinate with HR on attendance data extraction and troubleshoot device failures
* Manage device firmware and software updates; coordinate vendor support for hardware issues
* IT Helpdesk and Staff Support
* First\-line IT support for all 50\+ staff across 6 locations — hardware issues, software queries, account access problems
* Respond to support requests within 24 hours; resolve or escalate within 3 working days
* Provide hands\-on support at centre locations through scheduled visits (minimum monthly) and emergency visits when required
* Conduct basic IT literacy orientation for new staff on Day 1 as part of the onboarding process
* Google Workspace Administration
* Administer Protsahan’s Google Workspace: create and deactivate user accounts, manage shared drives, set access permissions
* Enforce the Shared Drive folder structure per ADM SOPs — ensure staff create and store files in Shared Drive, not personal My Drive
* Manage storage quotas, conduct periodic access audits, and generate usage reports for ED
* Troubleshoot Google Workspace issues for staff
* IT Security and Data Protection Compliance
* Enforce Protsahan’s IT and Data Protection Policy across all locations
* Implement and maintain password policies, device locking, and access control practices
* Support compliance with DPDP Act 2023 requirements — data inventory, access logs, incident response
* Conduct quarterly IT security audits across all 6 locations and report findings to ED
* Manage software licensing: track all licences, renewals, and compliance — no unlicensed software on Protsahan devices
* Programme Equipment Support
* Support Canon DSLR camera geotagging setup at all GECs: Canon Camera Connect app pairing, Location Services configuration, and staff training per SOP\-EE\-07
* Troubleshoot programme AV equipment, projectors, and other tech used in GEC activities
* Ensure camera and device firmware is kept up to date
* Vendor Management
* Maintain a vendor register for all IT service providers: ISP, hardware, CCTV, biometric, software
* Obtain comparative quotes for hardware and service procurement per Finance SOPs
* Monitor vendor service quality and SLA compliance; escalate persistent issues to ED


**Qualifications**
**Required**
* Diploma or degree in IT, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field
* 2 to 4 years of experience in IT administration, systems administration, or IT helpdesk
* Hands\-on experience managing Google Workspace (user admin, Shared Drive, permissions)
* Working knowledge of WiFi and LAN network management
* Experience with CCTV systems and/or biometric attendance devices
* Basic understanding of data protection and IT security principles
* Ability to work independently across multiple locations with minimal supervision
* Willingness to travel across all 6 Delhi centre locations as required


**Preferred**
* Prior experience in an NGO or social sector organisation
* Familiarity with DPDP Act 2023 (Digital Personal Data Protection) requirements
* Experience with asset management and maintaining IT asset registers
* Relevant certifications: CompTIA A\+, Google Workspace Administrator, or equivalent


**What We Expect**
 This role is not a 9\-to\-5 desk job. When the biometric device at a centre fails on a Monday morning, you are the person who resolves it — not who logs a ticket and waits. You will be expected to:
   

  

* Be responsive. Staff across 6 locations depend on functional equipment to run their programmes.
* Be proactive. Don’t wait for things to break — maintain, audit, update.
* Own the documentation. Every device, every vendor, every access permission must be on record — not in your head.
* Understand the stakes. Protsahan works with vulnerable children. IT failures have programme consequences. Data breaches have child protection consequences.


**How To Apply**
 Send your CV and a brief note on your relevant experience to hr@protsahan.co.in with the subject line: Application — IT Systems Administrator.
   

  

*Protsahan India Foundation is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.*

title: Technical Analyst(SAP, EPM, OneStream)
description:
**Overview**
**WELCOME TO** 
**SITA**

 We're the team that keeps airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our tech and communication innovations are the secret behind the success of the world’s air travel industry.
   

  

 You'll find us at 95% of international hubs. We partner closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients, each with their own unique needs and challenges. Our goal is to find fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to make their operations run like clockwork. Want to be a part of something big?
   

  

 Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
   

  

**About The Role \& Team**
 As a Technical Analyst, you will support the administration, enhancement, and optimization of the OneStream platform while working closely with Finance stakeholders. Reporting to the Lead Technical Analyst, you will be part of the IS
 **EPM team** 
 responsible for supporting the OneStream application.
   

  

 This role is suited to an individual who can bridge the gap between business and technology, combining technical capabilities with a strong understanding of financial processes to support our digital transformation initiatives.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Application Support \& Operations: Support the day\-to\-day operation of the OneStream application and manage user administration, security setup, metadata maintenance, and workflow configuration.
* Finance Transformation \& Enhancements: Support Finance Transformation initiatives through system enhancements, application testing, data analysis, defect analysis, and issue resolution.
* Financial Cycle Execution: Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting cycles.
* Data Integration \& Reconciliation: Assist with data integration, data loads, and reconciliation activities to ensure system data accuracy.
* Automation \& Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to automate manual processes using AI, digital tools, and automation technologies.
* Documentation \& User Support: Create and maintain thorough technical and functional documentation while providing functional support to system users.


**Qualifications**
**ABOUT YOUR SKILLS**
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Experience: 2–5 years of experience in a Finance Systems, Technical Analyst, or Finance\-related role (such as FP\&A, Financial Reporting, Consolidation, or Accounting).
* EPM Systems: Hands\-on experience with OneStream is preferred; knowledge of other EPM/CPM solutions is a plus.
* Technical Proficiency: Solid understanding of SAP, databases and basic coding concepts
* Domain Knowledge: Practical understanding of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting processes, financial consolidation, and group reporting concepts.
* Innovation \& Automation: Experience or exposure to AI, digital tools, and automation technologies.
* Analytical Mindset: Strong analytical, data analysis, and problem\-solving skills.
* Collaboration: Clear communication skills, with priority given to candidates possessing both finance and technical backgrounds to collaborate effectively between business and technology teams.
* Growth Mindset: Eager to learn, take initiative, and grow in a fast\-paced environment.


**What We Offer**
 We’re all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We’re really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
   

  

* 🏡 Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team’s needs)
* ⏰ Flex Day: Make your workday suit your life and plans.
* 🌎 Flex Location: Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.
* 🌿Employee Wellbeing: We’ve got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health – a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
* 🚀Professional Development: Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning!
* 🙌🏽 Competitive Benefits: Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.
* SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self\-identify in the application process.

**At least 3 years of hands\-on experience**

title: SAP Group Reporting Consultant
description:
**Company Description** 
 Intrasoft Middle East is a leading digital solutions provider with over 25 years of experience and more than 3,000 man\-years of expertise in business transformation and complex project delivery across the Middle East and Africa. The company has successfully implemented large\-scale projects in banking, telecommunications, enterprise, and government, tailored to specific industry, regional, and regulatory needs. Intrasoft is trusted by hundreds of organizations, maintaining a 100% project success rate and long\-term client relationships. By delivering turnkey projects on both CapEx and OpEx models, the company aligns with clients’ financial and operational priorities. As a strategic partner to global technology leaders such as Oracle, SAP, and Dell, Intrasoft builds scalable, secure, and future\-ready IT ecosystems.
   

**Role Description** 
 The SAP Group Reporting Consultant will work part\-time in a remote capacity, supporting clients in designing, configuring, and maintaining SAP Group Reporting solutions. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include gathering and analyzing financial consolidation requirements, mapping them to SAP functionalities, and ensuring accurate group financial reporting and compliance with relevant standards. The consultant will collaborate with finance and IT stakeholders, develop functional specifications, perform system testing, and support data migration and validation activities. The role also involves providing advisory services, troubleshooting issues, preparing documentation, and offering user training to optimize reporting processes. The consultant is expected to participate in continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring that implemented solutions remain aligned with evolving business and regulatory needs.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial and system requirements.
* Financial reporting and financial statements expertise, including consolidation concepts and compliance with relevant accounting standards.
* Background in finance, with familiarity in corporate performance management and group accounting processes.
* Consulting skills, including stakeholder management, requirements gathering, and solution presentation.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP Group Reporting or related SAP financial consolidation tools.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CPA, CMA, SAP certification) are an advantage.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage part\-time schedules, and meet project deadlines.
* Strong communication skills in English; additional regional languages are a plus.
* Experience in digital transformation or large\-scale ERP implementations within the Middle East or Africa is beneficial.

title: Channel SE - Identity Security
description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

****Who We Are****
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

****Job Summary****
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
   

  

 Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
   

  

 We have the vision of a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. These aren’t easy goals to accomplish – but we’re not here for easy. We’re here for better. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
   

  

 We’re changing the nature of work. Palo Alto Networks is evolving to meet the needs of our employees now and in the future through FLEXWORK, our approach to how we work. From benefits to learning, location to leadership, we’ve rethought and recreated every aspect of the employee experience at Palo Alto Networks. And because it FLEXes around each individual employee based on their individual choices, employees are empowered to push boundaries and help us all evolve, together.
   

  

******Job Summary** 
 :****
 We are seeking a skilled and motivated Channel Domain Consultant to join our team to support the North Asia region. In this critical partner\-facing role, the Channel Systems Engineer will act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for PANW Idira Identity Security products and solutions. The individual will foster and nurture relationships with technical partners, including System Integrators (SI), Value Added Resellers (VAR), Managed Service Providers (MSP), and other strategic partners. This role requires a combination of technical expertise, business acumen, and strong communication skills to enable and guide partners in delivering best\-in\-class Identity Security Management solutions including Human Identity Security, Machine Identity Security, Agentic AI Identity Security.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be responsible for driving partner Activation, ecosystem integrations, technical solution design, and supporting partners throughout the sales lifecycle. They will also play a key role in the development and execution of technical go\-to\-market (GTM) strategies.
   

  

******Key Responsibilities:******
****Partner Activation \& Ecosystem Integration:****
* Foster and build strong relationships with technical partners (SI, VAR, MSP) to expand the reach and success of solutions.
* Lead partner Activation efforts by creating training and certification pathways, including developing and improving certification processes.
* Collaborate with Technical Alliances to ensure the correct integration and development of technical selling plans.
* Work on partner onboarding and knowledge transfer, ensuring partners are equipped with the tools, knowledge, and resources to successfully position and sell products.
* Develop and implement Activation programs that educate and empower partners to be self\-sufficient in selling and supporting solutions.


******Solution Design \& Technical Strategy:******
* Gather and analyze end\-customer requirements from partners, translating business needs into technical solutions and system architectures.
* Provide technical leadership by designing and delivering tailored solutions architectures for partner\-engaged end\-customer projects.

**Project Role :** 
 Application Support Engineer
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Act as software detectives, provide a dynamic service identifying and solving issues within multiple components of critical business systems.

 NEXThink
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA

 15 years full time education
   

  

**Summary**
 Responsible to own NEXTHINK platform, analyze the real\-time data from the solution and to take necessary timely actions to improve the overall End User services.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
 Monitor the End user experience dashboards, digital scores, and alerts daily to check the overall performance scores of end users.
   

  

 Identify the top issues that are impacting the user experience scores
   

  

 Analyze the details of the issues and identify probable root cause of the issues and work with relevant teams to take necessary actions.
   

  

 Log proactive tickets for the identified issues and assign it to the relevant teams and track the issue until it is fixed to close the ticket.
   

  

 Create new investigations, dashboards, metrices, campaigns and reports to identify, track and resolve ongoing activities or identify potential issues that can be prevented to avoid outages and multiple tickets/calls flooding the service desk
   

  

 Coordinate with other service teams to ensure the identified issues are addressed by ways of proactive actions, logging tickets with relevant product vendors, track the progress of the cases and report the same to all stake holders.
   

  

 Would be responsible in developing, maintaining, and governing the usage of the scripts (Solutions) for the L1 engineers/ServiceNow/RTS teams who would use these to resolve known issues.
   

  

 Create, test, and maintain remote action solutions (Self Heal Use cases)
   

  

 Perform testing of collector upgrade packages, co\-ordinate with business owners and support teams for collector upgrade roll out. Co\-ordinate with Win10 engineering team to incorporate the new package into the core application list
   

  

 Escalate the problem tickets to Nexthink vendor
   

  

 Co\-ordinate with NEXTHINK vendor in performing new feature testing and troubleshooting critical applications
   

  

**Must Have Skills/Qualifications**
 Excellent Administration and Support skills on Windows 10 and MAC (where applicable)
   

  

 System Scripting and/or programming skills, preferably with PowerShell
   

  

 Should have at least fundamental certification in cloud technologies like Azure/AWS.
   

  

 Good verbal and written communication skills to connect with customers/teams at varying levels of the organization

 Project Management and ITIL Certifications.
   

  

 Familiar with Software Deployment Tools like SCCM, Intune and JAMF (where applicable)

 performance, controlled engineering data, consistent standards, reliable integrations, and
 



 responsive support for engineering teams.
 



  





**Role Scope** 




 Area Primary Focus
 



 SolidWorks CAD Administration \& User Support
 



 Installation/configuration, licenses, templates/libraries, performance, crashes, assemblies, references, workstation and user support SolidWorks PDM Administration \&
 



 Support Vaults, workflows, permissions, data cards, lifecycle/revisions, upgrades, migration, performance and PDM user support
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 A.
 **SolidWorks CAD Administration \& Support** 



* Administer SolidWorks, DraftSight, and eDrawings environments including installation,
* configuration, version rollout, patching, and license management.
* Provide L2/L3 support for SolidWorks issues including application launch failures, crashes, slow performance, graphics/display issues, large assembly performance,
* rebuild errors, missing/broken references, open/save problems, add\-in issues, printing/export, and license availability.
* Troubleshoot whether an issue is caused by SolidWorks settings, user profile, CAD model/data, workstation hardware/graphics, network, license server, PDM integration, or server\-side services.
* Manage SolidWorks templates, sheet formats, design libraries, Toolbox/standard parts, routing standards, macros, and controlled CAD settings.
* Support CAD workstation optimization and recommend suitable hardware specifications for engineering workloads.
* Support engineers using SolidWorks Routing (Piping, Electrical, or Tubing) where applicable.
* Document recurring CAD issues and fixes, prepare user guides, and train users on correct CAD practices and performance best practices.



  





**B. SolidWorks PDM Administration \& Support** 



* Administer SolidWorks PDM Professional/Standard environments, including vaults, users/groups, permissions, workflows, lifecycle states, transitions, and data cards.
* Manage revision control, metadata, folder structures, document controls, and engineering release processes in PDM.
* Provide L2/L3 support for PDM user issues including login/access, check\-in/check\-out, transitions, permissions, file visibility, references, metadata/data cards, and vault performance.
* Support PDM server/client upgrades, version compatibility, patching, testing, rollout, and rollback planning.
* Participate in PDM implementation, data cleanup, migration, metadata mapping, reference validation, and controlled cutover activities.
* Monitor PDM performance and coordinate with database, network, infrastructure, and vendor teams when issues cross system boundaries.
* Maintain PDM technical documentation, support procedures, knowledge articles, and change records.
* Shared Responsibilities
* Manage incidents, service requests, problems, and changes through ITSM processes and tools.
* Coordinate testing and user acceptance before production CAD/PDM changes.
* Work with engineering, IT, global locations, and external partners to resolve crosssystem issues.
* Identify recurring problems and implement permanent improvements to reliability and user productivity.
* Required Qualifications
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Industrial Engineering, Engineering IT, or a related discipline.
* Experience: 5\-6 years of relevant experience with hands\-on administration/support of SolidWorks and SolidWorks PDM. Candidates should demonstrate meaningful experience in both areas, not only design or end\-user usage.



  





**Required Technical Skills** 



* • SolidWorks administration and end\-user troubleshooting: installation, configuration, licenses, templates/libraries, performance, crashes, large assemblies, references, and workstation issues.
* SolidWorks PDM administration: vaults, workflows, permissions, data cards, lifecycle/revisions and production support.
* Strong practical understanding of SolidWorks design/drafting and how CAD data behaves in a managed PDM environment.
* Experience with upgrades, deployments, implementation and/or data migration.
* Knowledge of CAD workstation hardware, graphics considerations, network dependencies and application performance troubleshooting.
* Structured incident troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, documentation and user communication.
* Preferred Skills
* SolidWorks Routing experience.
* API, macros, scripting or automation exposure.
* ServiceNow, Jira, or other ITSM tool experience.
* Multi\-site/global PDM implementation exposure.
* Experience supporting manufacturing engineering teams.



  





**Success Measures** 



* Stable SolidWorks and PDM availability with timely user support.
* Reduced repeat incidents through root\-cause fixes and CAD/PDM standardization.
* Consistent templates, libraries, permissions and engineering release processes.
* Controlled upgrades and migrations with minimal engineering disruption.

title: Customer Experience Specialist
description:
**What You'll Own**
* Escalation ownership: Escalated tickets across chat, email, and voice — taking over conversations that frontline agents have flagged as high\-risk, high\-emotion, or high\-value.
* De\-escalation on live chat: Reading a chat in real time and choosing the right de\-escalation approach — acknowledging the issue, controlling pace, and closing the loop — instead of following a script word for word.
* Cross\-team coordination: Coordinating with logistics partners (BlueDart, Delhivery, and others), warehouse, and returns teams to get a real answer for the customer, not a placeholder.
* Chat throughput: Typing fast and accurately enough to run concurrent chats without the customer feeling like they're waiting on you.

* Root\-cause flagging: Flagging repeat escalation patterns (a courier, a SKU, a process gap) to the Team Lead instead of just closing tickets one by one.

* Prior experience in logistics, courier, or e\-commerce operations, where you've actually dealt with delayed orders, failed deliveries, refunds, or shipment disputes.
* A track record of calming down an upset customer on chat in real time — not just following an escalation matrix.
* Expert\-level typing speed and accuracy, comfortable managing multiple live chats at once.
* Excellent spoken and written English — confident on calls, clear and error\-free over email.
* A calm, sharp presence under pressure. You don't get rattled, and you don't let a customer's tone dictate yours.

* Have knowledge about the product journey and the return functiality.

**Role**
 As our new L1/L2 Business Central Consultant you will be responsible to provide L1/L2 functional support for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central from India, with a focus on finance\-related tickets and stakeholder support.
   

  

 You will resolve standard and moderately complex Business Central issues, guide users, document standard resolutions, identify recurring issues and automation opportunities, and escalate configuration, integration or development issues to L3 support when required.

* Guide finance and business users through correct process steps and standard resolutions.
* Reproduce issues, collect evidence, validate business impact and document resolutions clearly.
* Escalate complex configuration, integration, data, development or process design issues to L3 support.


**Finance process \& application support**
* Support finance stakeholders with day\-to\-day Business Central issues and questions.
* Guide users on correct system use, standard processes and workaround options where relevant.
* Help distinguish between user error, process issue, system defect and configuration/change need.
* Communicate progress clearly and follow up with users until the issue is resolved.


**Ticket escalation \& coordination**
* Prioritize work based on urgency, business impact and agreed service levels.
* Communicate clear updates to finance users and global support teams.
* Coordinate with Service Desk when tickets involve identity, access, devices or intake quality.
* Ensure escalated tickets contain sufficient documentation, screenshots, reproduction steps and impact assessment.
* Ability to work effectively within a global support model, with sufficient overlap with European business hours.


**Knowledge, documentation \& automation opportunities**

* Contribute to root\-cause follow\-up and improvements in finance support processes.

 We are looking for a motivated individual holding a relevant degree and a minimum of 5\+ years of full\-time experience in a similar role with supporting Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central in an L1/L2 support, consultant and application support role.
   

  

 You have a strong functional understanding of finance processes, including invoice processing, posting errors, expenses, time registration and master data. Experience with Allvue or similar fund/investment management
   

  

 platforms are an advantage.
   

  

 ITIL certified or experienced with incident, request, knowledge and problem management is a plus.

* Strong cross\-cultural experience working with stakeholders across different countries, time zones and working cultures.

 As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

description:

 WELCOME TO SITA
   

  

 At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
   

  

 You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients.  PURPOSE
   

  

 Coordinates and oversees the resolution of critical incidents ensuring minimal business impact and swift restoration of services through structured processes and effective communication (and triggers crisis management process).
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* As Senior Analyst, Incident Management, you will serve as the operational control tower for Major Incidents and Priority 1 incidents across the Digital Customer Organization (DCO) and Portfolio Service Operations (PSO). You will establish command and control, coordinate the right technical and business resources, and maintain a disciplined focus on restoring customer services while minimizing operational, financial, reputational, and customer impact.
* You will be accountable for the quality and pace of end\-to\-end major incident governance, including impact assessment, stakeholder mobilization, technical and customer bridge management, escalation, communications, recovery validation, documentation, and post\-incident follow\-through. You will support the accountable Incident Manager and ensure that resolver teams retain ownership of technical diagnosis and remediation.
* Reporting to the Manager, Major Incident Management, you will be part of the Digital Customer Organization (DCO)function responsible for service resilience, customer confidence, consistent global incident response, and the continued transformation and maturity of Incident Management.
* You will collaborate with DCO Service Desks, PSO resolver teams, Customer Service Managers (CSO), Site Reliability Engineers (SRE), Service Practice Owners, Product and Engineering teams, Problem Management, Change Enablement, Vendor Management (VMO), suppliers, and senior stakeholders. Through these partnerships, you will strengthen DCO and PSO integration, improve operational handovers, and convert incident learning into sustainable service improvements.
* Lead and coordinate Major Incidents and P1 incidents from declaration through service restoration and formal closure, maintaining a clear command structure, accurate situational awareness, and momentum toward recovery.
* Rapidly evaluate technical, customer, and business impact; validate priority; initiate the appropriate Major Incident or crisis pathway; and ensure compliance with agreed SLAs, OLAs, customer commitments, and escalation procedures.
* Mobilize and coordinate DCO, PSO, SRE, Product, Engineering, vendor, supplier, and specialist resolver teams, establishing clear accountabilities, time\-bound actions, dependencies, and escalation points.
* Establish and facilitate technical, customer, and management bridges, keeping discussions outcome\-focused, recording decisions and actions, challenging stalled progress, and escalating risks, resource gaps, or conflicting priorities.
* Deliver accurate, concise, and timely communications for customers, operations, senior leadership, and executives, clearly presenting impact, recovery actions, workarounds, risks, assumptions, estimated next updates, and service status.
* Maintain a complete and auditable incident record in the ITSM platform, including business impact, chronology, ownership, decisions, evidence, communications, recovery validation, links to related Problems and Changes, and closure details.
* Produce high\-quality Post\-Major Incident Reports (PMIRs), executive summaries, and post\-incident review packs; facilitate blameless learning reviews that identify control gaps, contributing factors, and practical opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate Root Cause Analysis and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) with Problem Management and technical owners, ensuring actions are risk\-based, measurable, assigned, due\-dated, tracked, and closed only after effectiveness is verified.
* Analyze incident performance and trends, including MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, repeat incidents, business impact, communication timeliness, escalation quality, action ageing, and customer feedback; translate insights into prioritized improvement plans.
* Advance the maturity of Incident Management through playbooks, escalation matrices, knowledge articles, templates, simulations, training, automation opportunities, governance reviews, and stronger integration across DCO, PSO, SRE, CSO, VMO, and Service Practices.


**Qualifications**
 EXPERIENCE
   

  

 Preferably 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in a customer\-focused service or support role within a large\-scale enterprise environment. Experience should include Customer Support, Service Desk, Help Desk, Call Centre, Incident Management, Service Operations, NOC, Command Centre, or IT Operations.
   

  

**NICE TO HAVE**
* ITIL 4 Foundation/Practitioner, SRE, Agile, DevOps, Lean, Six Sigma, or related Service Management certifications.
* Experience supporting mission\-critical environments such as aviation, travel technology, telecommunications, cloud services, managed infrastructure, SaaS platforms, or financial services, with exposure to executive communications, crisis management, and business continuity processes.
* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms, observability and monitoring tools (Splunk, Dynatrace, etc), operational analytics, AI Ops, and Incident Management transformation initiatives.


 Candidates should demonstrate strong customer engagement skills and practical experience supporting a broad range of services and products at intermediate to advanced levels. Experience or working knowledge of airline and travel industry operations, applications, and customer service environments is highly desirable.
   

  

**Knowledge \& Skills**
**IT Service Management Knowledge**
* Advanced practical understanding of ITIL\-based Incident and Major Incident Management, including interfaces with Problem, Change, Event, Knowledge, Service Level and Continual Improvement practices.

title: Manager, Quality – Digital Systems
description:
**Role Summary:**
 The Manager, Quality – Digital Systems is a business\-facing role that serves as the primary point of contact between RQA’s digital quality systems and the stakeholders who depend on them, with working technical depth in Veeva eQMS administration and GxP\-regulated system operations anchoring that work. This role is accountable for the reliable administration and continuous improvement of Veeva eQMS processes, including access management, business administration, release coordination, and reporting. The successful candidate will bring enough configuration fluency \- understanding vault object relationships, shared versus instance\-specific configuration, and the downstream consequences of proposed system changes \- to translate technical trade\-offs into clear guidance for stakeholders and support faster, better\-informed decisions on enhancement requests and system design questions.
   

  

 The successful candidate must communicate clearly across technical and business audiences, understand stakeholder needs, assess business and technical trade\-offs, and support technology decisions that advance quality operations and broader business objectives. Beyond day\-to\-day operations, this role independently represents the RQA Digital Systems team within cross\-functional programs and enterprise initiatives, scoping RQA’s responsibilities within a given program and developing and driving the execution plan on behalf of the team. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy, maintaining clear situational awareness across assigned responsibilities and bringing issues and decisions forward proactively.
   

  

 This position requires strong communication and analytical skills, working Veeva domain knowledge, genuine curiosity about applying AI and emerging technology to quality operations, and the ability to operate effectively in a regulated pharmaceutical environment — both as a business partner and as an accountable owner of complex, cross\-functional work.
   

  

**ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES:**
**Veeva eQMS Operations \& Administration**
* Serve as the primary business administrator for Veeva eQMS on behalf of Regulatory Quality Assurance.
* Triage and resolve business admin requests requiring business\-level judgment, partnering with technical teams on complex issues.
* Own access request intake and provisioning across RQA’s digital systems environments.
* Support Veeva release coordination through UAT, business approvals and communications, and production deployments.
* Maintain and continuously improve job aids, quick reference guides, and user\-facing documentation for Veeva eQMS and integrated supporting tools, keeping materials current across system releases.
* Develop, prepare, and deliver reporting across functional areas.


**eQMS Systems Expertise \& Advisory**
* Provide guidance on Veeva vault configuration options in support of business needs, including object relationships, shared configuration dependencies, and the downstream impact of proposed changes, partnering with technical teams to fill configuration depth as needed.
* Support the triage and formulation of eQMS enhancement requests, providing business context and impact assessment alongside stakeholder needs and operational impacts to inform prioritization and decision\-making.
* Stay current on Veeva platform developments and GxP digital systems best practices, especially with respect to emerging AI technologies, applying that knowledge to identify and champion opportunities to modernize system design and operations.
* Participate in eQMS governance forums, representing RQA Digital Systems’ interests and staying current on platform developments.


**Cross\-Functional Program Support**
* Independently represent the RQA Digital Systems team within enterprise programs and initiatives requiring digital systems support, scoping team responsibilities, developing execution plans, and delivering against them.
* Maintain clear ownership of workstream status and decisions; proactively surface blockers or escalation points to leadership.
* Coordinate with Pfizer Digital and cross\-functional teams to support enterprise quality data integrity and system continuity efforts.


**Reporting \& Data Operations**
* Issue clear and timely communications, ensuring stakeholders are informed and aligned on timelines and expected outcomes.
* Execute periodic data extracts and reporting tasks, including basic dashboarding and data queries, in support of regulatory and quality operations, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and appropriate documentation.
* Develop and maintain operational documentation and user guidance for current and legacy quality systems to ensure operational continuity.
* Gather, synthesize, and prepare materials for stakeholder communications and leadership briefings, translating system and data insights into accessible formats.


**Transformation \& Continuous Improvement**
* Proactively identify opportunities for meaningful process improvement and digital transformation within RQA’s quality systems operations, bringing both technical grounding and operational context to proposed solutions.
* Apply practical AI knowledge to evaluate use cases, partner with technical teams, and drive adoption of AI\-enabled solutions.
* Contribute to and support broader organizational transformation initiatives, including AI integration into quality workflows, eQMS process redesign, and platform evolution.
* Stay current on Veeva platform capabilities, GxP digital systems trends, and regulatory expectations, applying emerging best practices to improve the team’s operations and delivery.


**QUALIFICATIONS:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Information Systems, Computer Science or a related field with 5\+ years of relevant industry experience; advanced degree preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to produce clear documentation, user\-facing guidance, and stakeholder\-ready reports.
* Demonstrated experience working directly and iteratively with business stakeholders to understand their underlying needs and workflows.
* Working knowledge of Veeva Vault eQMS or a comparable enterprise quality/GxP system, including working knowledge of vault object relationships and configuration dependencies.
* Demonstrated, hands\-on curiosity about AI\-enabled tools, automation, or advanced analytics, with concrete examples of applying them to improve processes and drive innovation.
* Experience in a GxP\-regulated pharmaceutical or biotech environment with demonstrated understanding of quality management system processes.
* Proven ability to operate autonomously and collaboratively on complex, cross\-functional work.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; able to assess the downstream impact of system changes and translate business needs into actionable decisions.


**Preferred:**
* Basic coding, scripting, and/or dashboarding experience (e.g., SQL, Power BI, Spotfire, or similar).
* Background as a Veeva Vault business administrator, business analyst, or similar business\-technology liaison role.
* Experience with Veeva Vault configuration in a pharma or CRO setting, including participation in system releases, eQMS governance forums, or enhancement request management.
* Familiarity with Pfizer enterprise data and/or source systems.
* Exposure to data platforms – Snowflake, DSS/Dataiku – or related data engineering tools.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Power Automate or similar automation tools.

title: IT AI and Automation Analyst
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.
   

  

 Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Responsibilities \-**
**AI \& Automation Enablement Responsibilities**
* Design, build, and maintain AI\-driven support workflows using Microsoft Copilot and related platforms
* Develop and manage Copilot Studio agents integrated with ITSM, asset management, IT catalog, and request management systems
* Build Power Automate flows and API\-based automations to reduce repetitive Tier 1 and Tier 2 support tasks

* Identify high\-volume ticket patterns and propose scalable automation solutions
* Maintain and optimise automation scripts, workflows, and AI prompt structures
* Monitor chatbot and automation performance using usage analytics and continuously improve effectiveness
* Ensure governance, auditability, and security controls are applied to all automation implementations
* Research emerging AI tools relevant to IT operations and propose pilot initiatives
* This role is expected to spend a meaningful portion of time driving automation initiatives alongside core support responsibilities.


**Core IT Service Desk Responsibilities**
* Local support of the Gurgaon office on site 5 days a week
* Global support of all Sprinklr users
* Tracking and documenting all support activities within the ITSM platform
* Supporting macOS, Windows, AV, and enterprise software including Microsoft 365, Adobe, and cloud SaaS applications
* Laptop provisioning, inductions, hardware troubleshooting, and repair
* Conference room, telephony, printer, and office network support
* Application deployment, upgrades, and performance troubleshooting
* Endpoint management and antivirus security enforcement
* Supporting high\-level events and proactive monitoring of meeting rooms
* Onboarding and offboarding support including device preparation, access provisioning, and secure asset return
* Collaborating with cross\-regional IT teams on escalated issues
* Maintaining SOPs, knowledge base documentation, and user guides
* Supporting VIP users and executives with high\-priority service
* Coordinating with IT vendors


**About You \-**
* 5\+ years’ experience in IT Support or IT Operations within an enterprise environment
* Strong hands\-on experience supporting macOS, Windows, and Microsoft 365
* Experience with JAMF Pro and enterprise device lifecycle management
* Experience supporting senior stakeholders and executives


**Required Automation \& Systems Capability**
* Hands\-on experience building automations using Power Automate, scripting, or workflow platforms
* Practical experience working with APIs, connectors, or system integrations including authentication concepts and data flows
* Experience contributing to ITSM improvements, service catalog automation, or self\-service enablement
* Ability to analyse ticket trends and design scalable solutions that reduce repetitive manual effort
* Strong interest in AI\-driven service delivery and demonstrated experience experimenting with or implementing AI tools


**Professional Attributes**
* Self\-motivated with the ability to work independently
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with attention to detail
* Able to prioritise effectively across operational support and project work
* Comfortable working in a fast\-changing, global environment
* Proactive mindset with curiosity around emerging technologies


**Essential Technologies**
* Microsoft 365 including Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive
* Microsoft Power Platform including Power Automate
* ITSM platforms


**We focus on our mission** 
 : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
   

  

**EEO \- Our philosophy** 
 : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
   

  

 Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
   

  

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** 
 Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.

description:
**Short Summary** 




  





**Skills** 
 : Strong technical troubleshooting ability, customer service, excellent communication
 



**Experience** 
 : 2\-5 years of experience at a SaaS company
 



**Office location** 
 : Gurgaon, at Patina Tower, near Sikanderpur Metro Station, DLF Phase 1
 



**Company website** 
 : https://www.sumtracker.com
 



  





**About the Company** 




  





 Sumtracker is inventory management and replenishment software for Shopify and Amazon merchants, powering 2,000\+ e\-commerce brands across 50\+ countries. Founded in 2020, we're bootstrapped and profitable. We’ve built a product our customers genuinely love. We're a small, fast\-growing team based in Gurugram, working in\-office, and looking for people who want real ownership over their work.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for a Technical Support Engineer who sits at the intersection of technical troubleshooting and customer service \- someone who can dig into logs, APIs and integrations to actually solve a customer's problem, not just log a ticket.
 



  





 This is a role for someone who enjoys the puzzle of figuring out
 *why* 
 something broke \- whether it's a Shopify sync failure, a webhook that didn't fire, or a rate\-limit issue with a marketplace integration \- and can explain the fix to a customer in plain, non\-jargon language.
 



  





 You'll work closely with engineering and product to escalate genuine bugs, and you'll be the voice of the customer internally, flagging patterns before they become bigger problems.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 This is a high\-ownership individual contributor role
 



  




* **Troubleshoot \& resolve** 
 : Diagnose technical issues customers report \- bugs, integration failures, configuration problems, API errors. Reproduce issues, check logs, and identify root causes
* **Escalate with clarity** 
 : When something is a genuine bug, escalate to engineering with clear reproduction steps so it can be fixed fast
* **Manage expectations** 
 : Keep customers informed on timelines for fixes and workarounds
* **Go deep on integrations** 
 : Understand Sumtracker's architecture well enough to debug beyond surface\-level \- reading logs, making light SQL/API calls, and understanding how integrations like Shopify, Amazon and other marketplaces sync, fail, and recover
* **Document \& build knowledge** 
 : Write and update help center articles and FAQs based on recurring issues; maintain internal runbooks for common problems
* **Support onboarding** 
 : Occasionally get involved in onboarding or implementation for technically complex accounts



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* **Proven Experience** 
 : 2\-5 years of experience in a technical support, support engineering, or similar customer\-facing technical role, ideally at a SaaS company
* **Technical Aptitude** 
 : Comfortable reading logs, working with APIs, and picking up enough of a product's architecture to debug real issues \- prior hands\-on exposure to SQL, APIs, or webhooks is a strong plus
* **Excellent Communication** 
 : Exceptional oral and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in plain language
* **Customer\-Centric Approach** 
 : A genuine passion for helping customers succeed and a strong commitment to providing outstanding service
* **Ownership\-Driven** 
 : Ability to work independently, take initiative, and manage multiple tickets/issues effectively



  





**Why should you join us?** 




  




* **Competitive compensation** 
 : Attractive salary with annual increments
* **Growth opportunities** 
 : Take on a pivotal role with full ownership, accelerating your career
* **Global exposure** 
 : Work with customers across the US, UK, Australia, and more
* **Cutting\-edge work** 
 : Solve real problems using AI and modern tools



  





**Work Policy** 




 We are an in\-office company with a 5\-day work week
 



  





**Team and Culture** 




 At Sumtracker, we foster a culture that values autonomy, ownership, and transparency.
 



  




* **Process\-driven and autonomous:** 
 Well\-defined processes that empower you to work independently
* **Transparency:** 
 Open communication about company progress and individual contributions
* **Direct access:** 
 Share your thoughts and ideas directly with the founders
* **Great workspace:** 
 Work from our office at WeWork Platina Tower

title: Contact Center Specalist
description:
**About Us**
 Join us at Orange Business!
   

  

 We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
   

  

 Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Drive the delivery and continuous improvement of robust, scalable contact center solutions by managing escalations, integrating advanced technologies, and optimizing omnichannel interactions to support seamless customer experiences across Orange’s platform ecosystem.
   

  

* Troubleshoot and resolve escalated incidents related to IVR, call routing, SIP trunks, and omnichannel interactions.
* Collaborate with Genesys Support and vendors to address critical platform issues effectively.
* Manage incident response processes and conduct root cause analysis for outages and service disruptions.
* Provide operational support for Genesys Cloud CX, NICE CXone, and Webex Contact Center solutions aligned with business requirements.
* Develop and configure IVR flows, call routing strategies, and omnichannel interaction paths.
* Integrate Genesys Cloud with CRM systems such as Salesforce and Microsoft Dynamics, as well as databases and third\-party applications.
* Configure and optimize ACD, Workforce Management, and Workforce Engagement Management features.
* Guide the team in daily monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting of the contact center environments.
* Optimize SIP trunking, voice quality, and telephony infrastructure to ensure high performance.
* Manage user roles, permissions, and security configurations within the Genesys platform.
* Develop and maintain APIs, webhooks, and system integrations to enhance automation and scalability.
* Implement AI\-powered chatbots, speech analytics, and automation solutions to drive efficiency.
* Utilize cloud service providers such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud to support scalable integration solutions.


**About You**
 You bring over 5 years of experience in Contact Center Engineering, including a minimum of 3 years with hands\-on work in Genesys Cloud CX. You possess deep technical knowledge in ACD, IVR, SIP, WebRTC, and omnichannel functionality, along with experience in scripting and API integrations. You are proficient with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, and adept at integrating contact center solutions with CRM systems. Your background includes workforce engagement management and AI\-driven technologies, and you hold relevant certifications such as Genesys Cloud CX/NICE CXone CIP Core.
   

  

**Your professional skills:**
* Demonstrate extensive experience with Genesys Cloud CX and contact center engineering spanning more than 5 years.
* Apply in\-depth knowledge of telephony systems including ACD, IVR, SIP, WebRTC, and omnichannel communication features.
* Utilize programming and scripting skills in JavaScript, Python, JSON, and RESTful APIs to support system integrations and automation.
* Leverage expertise in cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud and adhere to security best practices.
* Integrate contact center platforms with CRM software including Salesforce, ServiceNow, and Microsoft Dynamics to enhance customer data flow.
* Employ hands\-on experience with Architects, Composer, and Interaction Routing tools within contact center environments.
* Incorporate workforce engagement solutions, speech analytics, and AI\-driven technologies to improve contact center operations.


**Your soft skills:**
* Effectively address and resolve complex technical problems with clear troubleshooting strategies.
* Communicate complex concepts and technical information clearly and professionally to diverse stakeholders.
* Adapt to evolving technologies and dynamic project requirements with flexibility and continuous learning.
* Collaborate effectively within cross\-functional teams to achieve shared goals and maintain operational excellence.


 Join Orange as a Contact Center Specialist to contribute to innovative customer experience solutions in a collaborative and dynamic environment. Your expertise will drive impactful enhancements across cloud\-based contact center platforms, enabling seamless interactions and operational excellence. Experience an environment that values skill development, adaptability, and continuous improvement, aligned with Orange’s mission to connect and empower communities.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Global Opportunities: Work in multi\-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: training programs and upskilling/re\-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well\-being programs and benefits, diversity \& inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.


**Only Your Skills Matter**
 Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neurotype, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled\-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

title: Data Migration Specialist
description:
**About Loop**
 Loop is a subscription management platform built for e\-commerce brands on Shopify. Our primary market is the US, with growing presence in Europe and ANZ.
   

  

 We are scaling rapidly, driven by a strong product and exceptional merchant experience. We grew 5x in 2023, 3x in 2024, and are on track for 2\.5x growth in 2025\. With $10M\+ ARR built through organic channels and a small, high\-performing team, we believe in doing more with less.
   

  

**Our DNA**
* High Agency action over instruction
* High Ethics trust is the foundation
* Positive Attitude solutions over excuses
* Impact\-Driven if it doesn't move the needle, it doesn't matter


**About The Data Migration Specialist Role**
 This role ensures merchants move to Loop smoothly by owning the technical side of onboarding and subscription data migration. You will manage end\-to\-end migration workflows, support onboarding specialists, troubleshoot issues, and maintain high data accuracy with zero\-error execution. **Ideal Profile**
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in a related role.

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced and dynamic team environment.

description:

 We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.
   

  

**What role will you play?**
 In this role, you will manage the day\-to\-day operations and governance of a portfolio of finance technology and analytics solutions, ensuring the reliable delivery and support of business\-critical reporting and data processes. You will work closely with various stakeholders to drive operational excellence, manage incidents and service performance, and deliver continuous improvements across the platform landscape. Leveraging your expertise in data analytics, Power BI, SQL, and modern data technologies, you will translate business requirements into scalable solutions while mentoring team members and fostering a strong service\-oriented culture.
   

  

**What You Offer**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, with 7\+ years’ experience in data analytics, technology delivery, production support, or operations management.
* Strong expertise in Power BI, SQL, Alteryx, and enterprise data platforms, including troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and support of business\-critical reporting solutions.
* Proven experience managing BAU operations, incident and problem management, service governance, and delivery oversight in a fast\-paced environment.

* Strong leadership, communication, and people management skills, including coaching, mentoring, performance management, team development, and driving continuous improvement with a high degree of ownership and accountability.

**Benefits**

title: Technical Support Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced
 **Technical Support Manager** 
 to lead, mentor, and scale B2B SaaS support operations. This role is accountable for delivering exceptional customer experiences, building a high\-performing technical support team, and driving cross\-functional collaboration to resolve complex customer issues. The ideal candidate has a proven background in B2B SaaS, preferably within hospitality technology, strong people leadership skills, and a practical understanding of how modern AI tools can improve support quality, efficiency, and scalability.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
**People Leadership \& Support Operations**
* Lead, coach, and scale a team of Technical Support Engineers delivering support across global communication channels, including chat, email, and phone.
* Establish, monitor, and improve key support metrics, including CSAT, Time to First Response, Mean Time to Resolution, and SLA compliance.
* Drive individual and team performance through regular one\-on\-ones, skill assessments, performance reviews, and career development planning.
* Promote clear ownership, accountability, urgency, and consistency in customer\-facing support execution.


**Cross\-Departmental Collaboration**
* Serve as the primary operational liaison between Technical Support, Engineering, Product Management, and Customer Success.
* Establish feedback loops that convert support ticket trends, recurring defects, and customer pain points into actionable insights for Product and Engineering teams.
* Partner with Customer Success to manage critical account escalations, protect high\-value customer relationships, and improve retention outcomes.
* Ensure escalations are clearly documented, prioritized, and resolved with appropriate urgency and follow\-through.


**AI \& Process Optimization**
* Evaluate, integrate, and champion AI\-driven tools such as auto\-triage, generative AI response drafting, automated ticket routing, and predictive analytics.
* Improve self\-service capabilities by strengthening knowledge base quality, AI\-powered search, and support documentation workflows.
* Balance automation with a high\-touch customer experience, ensuring efficiency gains do not reduce customer trust or issue ownership.
* Continuously identify workflow gaps, manual bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve support scale without sacrificing quality.


**Job Requirements**
* Experience \- Seeking a candidate with experience of 5\+ years in technical support, including at least 2 years in direct people management leading technical teams.
* Domain Expertise \- Strong background in B2B SaaS models. Hospitality technology experience, including PMS, POS, or guest management systems, is highly preferred.
* Technical Skills \- Familiarity with REST APIs, webhooks, database querying, system integrations, and enterprise support tools such as Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, and Jira.
* AI Exposure \- Hands\-on experience or demonstrated strategic understanding of incorporating AI tools into modern technical support workflows.
* Leadership \- Proven ability to mentor staff, manage high\-pressure client escalations, and build a collaborative, accountability\-driven team culture.


**Success Profile**
 The successful candidate will combine technical fluency, disciplined operational management, and strong people leadership. They should be comfortable operating in a fast\-moving B2B SaaS environment, translating customer issues into business and product insights, and using AI\-enabled tools to improve support speed, consistency, and scalability.
   

  

**Work Schedule**
 This position requires working in 24/7 rotational shifts, including evenings, late nights, and weekends. The role will be working in a hybrid work mode, with a minimum of two days required in the office each week, based in Hyderabad or Gurugram.

 These interactions span a range of support areas, including billing and payments, digital services, product and service enquiries, handset and device support, general or ad\-hoc queries, and account administration. title: Customer Support Executive
description:
**Job description:** 




 We are looking for a proactive Customer Support Officer to manage service operations, coordinate with field technicians, and ensure seamless customer support across pan\-India locations. The role requires strong communication skills and excellent working knowledge of Excel to manage data, reporting, and service tracking efficiently.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Develop and manage a 
 **pan\-India network of service technicians** 
  for installation and servicing of GPS tracking devices
* Plan and monitor 
 **daily installation and post\-installation schedules** 
  across locations
* Coordinate with customers and internal field teams for 
 **service scheduling and issue resolution**
* **Handle all customer communication via Email, Phone, and WhatsApp** 
  in a timely and professional manner
* Ensure 
 **follow\-ups within 24 hours** 
  and maintain a 
 **TAT of 24–48 hours** 
  for service requests
* Generate and manage 
 **repair invoices**
* **Maintain inventory of spares and consumables** 
  and coordinate logistics for dispatch across India
* Track and manage 
 **return of defective parts** 
  from technicians to the head office
* Provide 
 **support and guidance to field technicians** 
 , including conducting training sessions
* Monitor and supervise 
 **repairs and troubleshooting** 
  of GPS devices
* Prepare 
 **monthly failure and performance reports** 
  (Technician/Product/Region\-wise) using Excel

 **reporting and data tracking in ERP systems**

 **2\+ years of experience** 
  in managing service technicians for automotive/electrical installations

 **network of technicians across 100\+ locations**

 **communication skills** 
  (written \& verbal) – essential for customer handling and coordination

  for reporting, tracking, and analysis

 **service operations and logistics coordination**

* Strong 
 **analytical and problem\-solving skills** 
 , including root cause analysis

 **travel** 
  for technician hiring, training, and management

title: Desktop Support Engineer
description:
**Title:** 
 Desktop Support Engineer
 



**Experience:** 
 3\+ years
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram
 



**Notice Period:** 
 Immediate joiner or up to 1 month.
 



  





 We at Coforge are seeking a “Desktop Support Engineer" to provide end\-user IT support, VIP support, and audio\-visual event assistance. The candidate will be responsible for supporting senior leadership, resolving technical incidents, managing endpoint devices, and ensuring seamless IT operations across corporate offices and event venues.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**VIP \& Executive Support**



* Provide dedicated IT support to VIP users including Directors, VPs, MDs, CXOs, and CIO\-level stakeholders.
* Ensure quick resolution of hardware, software, network, and mobility\-related issues.
* Maintain high service levels and professionalism while interacting with business leaders.
* Handle priority incidents and escalations with minimal downtime.



**Desktop \& End\-User Support**



* Install, configure, and troubleshoot desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, and peripherals.
* Support Windows operating systems, Microsoft Office Suite, Outlook, Teams, and enterprise applications.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, networking, and user access issues.
* Perform system upgrades, software installations, and patch updates.
* Manage user accounts, password resets, and basic Active Directory\-related activities.



**Ticket Management**



* Log, track, update, and close incidents through ITSM/ticketing tools.
* Meet SLA commitments for incident resolution and service requests.
* Prepare incident reports and maintain support documentation.



**Audio\-Visual \& Event Support**



* Provide technical support for medium to large\-scale corporate events, town halls, leadership meetings, and boardroom sessions.
* Set up and troubleshoot audio\-visual equipment including projectors, video conferencing systems, microphones, speakers, and presentation devices.
* Support Microsoft Teams, Zoom, WebEx, and other collaboration platforms.
* Coordinate with facility and business teams to ensure smooth execution of events.



**Asset \& Inventory Management**



* Maintain inventory of IT assets and accessories.
* Track hardware allocation, replacements, warranty status, and stock availability.
* Ensure compliance with IT policies and security guidelines.



**Required Skills**



* Strong knowledge of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft Office 365\.
* Experience in desktop troubleshooting and end\-user support.
* Hands\-on experience with ticketing tools such as ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, Jira Service Management, or ManageEngine.
* Knowledge of Active Directory, Outlook, Teams, VPN, and basic networking concepts.
* Experience supporting executive leadership and VIP users.
* Expertise in audio\-video conferencing and meeting room technologies.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.



**Preferred Skills**



* Experience in enterprise/corporate IT environments.
* Knowledge of ITIL processes and service management concepts.
* Exposure to endpoint management and remote support tools.
* Certifications such as ITIL Foundation, Microsoft Fundamentals, or CompTIA A\+ will be an advantage.



**Qualification**



* Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university.
* Relevant experience in Desktop Support, End User Computing (EUC), or VIP Support roles.



**Work Schedule**



* Working Days: Monday to Saturday
* Shift Duration: 9 Hours
* Shift Window: Between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM
* Weekly Off: Sunday



**Key Attributes**



* Customer\-centric approach with excellent stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and handle critical issues independently.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
* Flexible to support business\-critical activities and corporate events.

title: IT Support Associate, IT Services Variable
description:
**Description**
 The Amazon Helpdesk is the first place for Amazon employees to go with technical questions and problems with Amazon's desktops, laptops, mobile devices, network services and software. The Amazon Helpdesk works with Amazon and Amazon service managers and other staff to maintain internal solutions and respond to employees’ technical issues. Additionally, they manage all the on\-premise infrastructure including servers, network device, telephony and printers.
   

  

 Amazon.com is looking for a dynamic and motivated IT Support Engineer to join their IT Services Team. If you are customer\-focused with strong problem\-solving skills and have experience with Chrome OS and Windows environments, we want to talk with you.
   

  

 As a member of the team you will have the opportunity to develop your career by maintaining and supporting Amazon’s unique corporate infrastructure, service platforms and employees. This is a challenging role that demands strong communication skills, technical, analytical and problem\-solving competencies and most importantly, customer obsession.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Provide ticket\-based, walk\-up and remote Helpdesk support for Amazon’s growing multi\-site user base and environments.
* Direct internal and external service provider engagements, as needed, in the processing of support requests for effective and timely resolution of issues.
* Manage various routine processes such as new hire onboards, computer life cycle management, asset management, computer imaging, hardware warranty support and hardware recycling.
* Participate in the development, implementation and administration of processes and procedures to ensure the reliability, recoverability, and optimum performance of user hardware and local services.
* Work in tandem with the rest of the IT Operations team to uphold system SLAs with a rotating On\-call schedule for production support issues.
* Research, procure, vet and deploy new hardware and software solutions.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Seeking a customer\-focused IT Support Associate who excels in Windows/Mac/Linux OS deployment, remote technical support, and comprehensive user hardware/software/peripheral assistance, while demonstrating expertise in LAN troubleshooting and hardware asset management. The ideal candidate will maintain detailed documentation while handling a high volume of urgent requests, displaying innovation, energy, and adaptability in new processes. They must be self\-motivated, able to work independently with minimal supervision, and maintain high productivity levels while managing ambiguous situations. This role requires someone who combines strong technical capabilities with genuine curiosity, commitment to team success, and an initiative in delivering hands\-on IT support across all platforms.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of corporate setting Windows, Mac or Linux Operating systems support experience
* Experience troubleshooting integrated and interdependent computer systems
* Experience maintaining zebra thermal printers, troubleshooting thin clients, PCs, scanners, and portable handheld terminals
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent


**Preferred Qualifications**
* CompTIA A\+, CompTIA Network\+, Cisco/CCNA, Linux (Redhat), Microsoft hardware (installation), AWS, or other industry relevant certifications
* Experience in a dynamic environment with a high degree of customer service
